International Conference on "Women Researchers in Electronics and Computing- WREC2023" (April 21 - 23, 2023) organised by Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, NITJ
title: International Conference on "Women Researchers in Electronics and Computing- WREC2023" (April 21 - 23, 2023) organised by Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, NITJ
desc: The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, NIT Jalandhar organized the 2nd International Conference "Women Researchers in Electronics and Computing- WREC2023" from 21-23 April 2023. The conference emphasized the contributions of women in the field of electronics and computing. The focus of the conference was on promoting and encouraging women engineers and motivating young girls to follow their academic interests to a career in engineering. A fact of great pride is that all organizers, conference chairs, and keynote speakers were women. With a view to inspire women engineers, pioneers, and successful women achievers in the domains of VLSI design, wireless sensor networks, communication, image and signal processing, machine learning, and emerging technologies had been identified from across the globe and invited to present their work and address the participants in this women oriented conference. The inauguration was graced by the presence of Shri S C Ralhan, Chairperson, NIT Jalandhar and Prof. Ranjana Agarwal, Director of CSIR-NIScPR, and Prof Binod Kumar Kanaujia, Director NITJ. Prof.
title: International Conference on "Women Researchers in Electronics and Computing- WREC2023" (April 21 - 23, 2023) organised by Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, NITJ

text:
International Conference on "Women Researchers in Electronics and Computing- WREC2023" (April 21 - 23, 2023) organised by Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, NITJ
Ranjana Agarwal talked about “Women’s equality and empowerment” in her inaugural talk. There were five Keynote Addresses during the conference: “Brain tumor classification and detection using machine and deep learning models” by Prof Irene Yu-Huan Gu, Chalmers University of Technology, Sweden, “Career opportunities in the Semiconductor Industry” by Er Binta Patel, Cloud Architect, INTEL, “Real-time implementation of wireless Sensor Network” by Prof S. Indu, DTU, Delhi, “System-on-chip designs and their implementation using Gamification” by Prof Gayatri Mehta, University of North Texas, and “5G Communication implementation issues and challenges” by Dr Rashmi Sharan Sinha, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore. There were eight paper presentation sessions and the Best Paper award was announced in each session. Conference proceedings will be published with Springer in their prestigious series “Lecture Notes in Electrical Engineering”.
title: International Conference on "Women Researchers in Electronics and Computing- WREC2023" (April 21 - 23, 2023) organised by Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, NITJ

title: First Edition of TEDx NIT Jalandhar (15th April, 2023)
desc: TEDxNITJ club, Dr. B R Ambedkar National Institute of Technology Jalandhar, Punjab, hosted its first TEDx event on April 15, 2023, During the event, Mr. Kapil Jindal and Mr. Devinder Maheshwari, co-founders of the startup Beebom, delivered a talk that was filled with reflections from their past experiences as IIT JEE aspirants and their journey to building their own company. In their talk, they shared anecdotes about their humble beginnings, such as their first apartment, their first laptop, and their first blog. Along with their passion for technology, they discussed how they adapted to changing trends, transitioning from blogs to videos to short-form content, and now incorporating AI into their work. The speakers also imparted valuable advice to the audience about the importance of consistency, creativity, and teamwork in building a successful community. They shared their strategies for maintaining a thriving community of 100,000 subscribers every day. Overall, the talk was informative and inspiring, highlighting the importance of resilience and adaptation in the fast-paced world of technology.

title: Press Conference on Implementation of National Education Policy 2020
desc: A press conference was organized at Dr B R Ambedkar National Institute of Technology (NIT) Jalandhar today on the occasion of three years of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. The conference was graced by esteemed dignitaries from prominent institutions including NIT Jalandhar, IIM Amritsar, IIT Ropar, AIIMS Bathinda, and Central University of Punjab. The conference brought together these eminent personalities, who are at the forefront of education and academia, to discuss the successful implementation of the groundbreaking National Education Policy. The central focus of the press conference was to shed light on the progressive measures undertaken in the implementation of the National Education Policy 2020, which aims to revolutionize India's education landscape and foster holistic development among students. At the conference, Sh. Rajinder Chaudhry, Additional Director General, Press Information Bureau (PIB), Chandigarh stated that the National Education Policy 2020 has laid the foundation for a transformative educational ecosystem that is student-centric and empowers learners to develop essential 21st-century skills.
title: Press Conference on Implementation of National Education Policy 2020

text:
Press Conference on Implementation of National Education Policy 2020
He emphasized the integration of technology and modern teaching methodologies to make education more accessible and inclusive. “NEP aims for universalization of education with 100% Gross enrollment ratio(GER)”, he added. Dr. Binod Kumar Kanojia, Director of NIT Jalandhar, reiterated the institute's commitment to aligning its curriculum with the NEP's vision of promoting interdisciplinary education and research-oriented learning. He highlighted that the policy's emphasis on promoting research and innovation will create a pool of skilled individuals who can address real-world challenges effectively. Dr. Nagarajan Ramamoorthy, Director of IIM Amritsar, emphasized that NEP 2020 aims to foster an entrepreneurial spirit among students, encouraging them to become job creators rather than just job seekers. He stated that he believes this will lead to the creation of a self-reliant and sustainable economy for the nation. Prof. R. P. Tiwari, Vice-Chancellor of Central University of Punjab, stated that the NEP envisions strengthening the educational infrastructure in India and expanding the reach of quality education to all corners of the country.
title: Press Conference on Implementation of National Education Policy 2020

text:
Press Conference on Implementation of National Education Policy 2020
He emphasized that this will create a vibrant and knowledgeable society that can contribute effectively to India's growth. “Through the National Education Policy, we envision fortifying India's educational infrastructure and extending the horizon of quality education to every nook and cranny of our nation. A vibrant and knowledgeable society, thus empowered, will undoubtedly steer India towards remarkable growth and prosperity”, he added. Associate Dean for Postgraduate Studies, Dr. Rakesh Kumar Maurya added that there have been several interdisciplinary PG programs started recently at IIT Ropar. For example, the MSc program in Data Scienc & Management has been started this year in collaboration with Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Amritsar. A joint PhD degree has also been started in collaboration with IIT Mandi. An MTech program in Computational Mechanics is also a multidisciplinary program started by the Mechanical engineering department.
title: Press Conference on Implementation of National Education Policy 2020

Prof. (Dr.) Akhilesh Pathak, Dean and officiating Director of AIIMS Bathinda, remarked that the NEP 2020 has paved the way for the integration of medical education with the larger education framework, promoting an interdisciplinary approach to healthcare. He believes this will result in producing well-rounded medical professionals with a broader understanding of societal and health-related challenges. The press conference served as a platform for the panel to highlight the progress made so far in the implementation of NEP 2020 and the collective efforts put forth by various educational institutions in achieving its objectives. With the united commitment of the academic community, policymakers, and stakeholders, the National Education Policy is poised to create a dynamic, skill-driven, and globally competitive education system.

Ambedkar National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar and pays tributes to the real heroes of the nation and submitting the soil and rice (akshat) in the “Amrit Kalash”. text:

The soil and rice from different villages of Punjab were collected by the students of NIT Jalandhar and submitted in this “Amrit Kalash”. This “Amrit Kalash” will be handed over to the block authority and then transported to New Delhi for the culmination of this campaign. title: National Innovation Day Celebration (15th October 2023)
desc: In a grand tribute to the legendary Dr. A.P.J Abdul Kalam on his birth anniversary, the National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar (NITJ) organized a two-day event on October 14th and 15th, celebrating, National Innovation Day. The event was organized by Dean (R&C), Prof. J N Chakraborty coordinated by Team Technical Affairs of NIT Jalandhar. The event was dedicated to celebrating innovation, entrepreneurship, and the spirit of scientific inquiry, which Dr. Kalam so passionately advocated. The Chief Guest for the event was Dr. Dapinder Kaur Bakshi, Joint Director Punjab state council of science and technology and a notable figure in the field of innovation and technology. The Guest of Honor was Prof. Cham, a distinguished academic, and Mr. Richard, a prominent figure in the world of entrepreneurship from Birmingham City University UK. Mr Sunil Chawla, DGM, Punjab Info tech graced the event as Special Guest. Registrar of NIT Jalandhar, Prof. Ajay Bansal graced the occasion with his presence.
title: National Innovation Day Celebration (15th October 2023)

text:
National Innovation Day Celebration (15th October 2023)
The event was a platform for engaging discussions and insightful talks on innovation, startup culture, entrepreneurship, and more. It aimed to inspire the budding innovators and entrepreneurs in the NITJ community to think creatively and take the road less travelled. Some of the key highlights of the event included discussions on innovation and its role in today's world, practical insights into startup creation and growth, and the unveiling of an exciting hatchery program designed to nurture and support young innovators. As the speakers and participants shared their experiences and expertise, it was evident that Dr. A.P.J Abdul Kalam's vision for a self-reliant and technologically advanced India continues to inspire and motivate the future generation. The National Innovation Day celebration at NIT Jalandhar was a resounding success, with a promise of a brighter and more innovative future for all. This event reinforced the institute's commitment to fostering a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship.
title: National Innovation Day Celebration (15th October 2023)

text:
National Innovation Day Celebration (14th October 2023)
title: National Innovation Day Celebration (14th October 2023)
desc: Dr. B R Ambedkar National Institute of Technology in Jalandhar hosted a vibrant Innovation Day, uniting entrepreneurial visionaries and pioneers. The event, held on 14th October 2023, featured esteemed honorees Prof Cham Athwal and Richard Scutt from Birmingham City University UK, who shared their profound insights into the world of innovation and entrepreneurship. Cham Athwal, a veteran with over three decades of experience at Birmingham City University, spoke of his journey and expertise. He founded BCU's DMTLab, renowned for pioneering work in image, audio, and video processing, as well as virtual and augmented reality research. Athwal's discussion delved into the distinctions between startup culture and academic tenure. His journey led to the creation of two startups, including PIXOFT.co.UK, which initiated as a government-funded technology transfer project, focusing on digital video and software engineering for the motor industry. The second venture, Faders (Semantic Audio Labs), introduced an intelligent music production system. Athwal emphasized the importance of innovative solutions and strategic marketing in the success of startups.
title: National Innovation Day Celebration (14th October 2023)

text:
National Innovation Day Celebration (14th October 2023)
Richard Scutt, Head of Incubation and Growth at BCU's STEAMhouse, shared his unique entrepreneurial journey, which began in the hospitality business in France and later transitioned to nurturing innovation at STEAMhouse. He discussed the fourfold goals of the enterprise journey and offered insights into the complexities of entrepreneurship. Also, during the event, Mr. Shibananda Das talked on the spirit for entrepreneurship. The event not only celebrated innovation but also encouraged transformative dialogues, fostering a culture of entrepreneurship among the academic community. The Innovation Day will continue its mission in the coming years, providing a platform for knowledge sharing and inspiring future entrepreneurs.
title: National Innovation Day Celebration (14th October 2023)

desc: Dr B R Ambedkar NIT Jalandhar celebrated the 75th Republic Day in the Institute on 26th January 2024 with great enthusiasm. The event commenced with unfurling of the National Flag by the Chairman cum Director of the institute, Prof. B. K. Kanaujia, followed by national anthem and a parade near the Administrative Building. text:
75th Republic Day Celebration at NIT Jalandhar
In his address, he emphasized the significance of the day, marking the moment when India became a republic through the enactment of its constitution. He highlighted the special connection between the institute and the day, given that NIT Jalandhar has been named after Dr. B R Ambedkar, the father of the constitution. Further, the Director of the institute, Prof. B. K. Kanaujia addressed the audience and congratulated all the faculty, staff and students. He started his address by paying a tribute to freedom fighters who have played a crucial role in the independence of the nation and adoption of our Constitution on 26th January,1950. He further emphasized that the significance of Republic Day lies not only in commemorating our Constitution but also in our reflection and commitment to progress and innovation. Technology plays a big role in education and thus education systems should use it to reach masses and deprived sections of the society.
title: 75th Republic Day Celebration at NIT Jalandhar

He further highlighted the achievements of the institute in the past year and outlined future developments for NIT Jalandhar. The institute witnessed significant growth in global rankings (351-400 in Times Higher Education Asia, 651-700 in QS Asia university ranking, 601-800 in THE world university ranking under Engineering category, and 46 in NIRF), bringing NIT Jalandhar along the top 50 premier institutes of the nation. Fresh undergraduate programs in Electronics and VLSI Engineering, Data Science and Engineering have been introduced. Newly initiated MTech programs such as Mathematics and Computing, Industrial Engineering and Data Analytics etc. reflect the institute’s commitment to staying ahead in the field of technological advancements. Besides this, the institute foresees a great infrastructure with projects of around Rs 240 crores sanctioned under HEFA. The proposed projects include several academic blocks, the Mega Boys for Boys Phase-III and 54 Type IV residences. The research initiatives of the institute have resulted in securing more than 20 crores in funding through 60 sponsored projects and joint projects bagged by faculty members.

text:
Poster Presentation Event - AI Pathways: Exploring Cross-Domain Innovations
title: Poster Presentation Event - AI Pathways: Exploring Cross-Domain Innovations
desc: On August 22, 2024, the Super Quant Coders (SQC) Club at Dr. B.R. Ambedkar NIT Jalandhar, in collaboration with the Department of Information Technology, hosted its Poster Presentation Event. Themed "AI Pathways: Exploring Cross-Domain Innovations," the event received 30 entries, out of which 16 were shortlisted for presentation, demonstrating unique applications of AI across various domains. Winners: 1st Prize: Tanveer - "Genomic Data Analysis for Personalised Medical Treatment" 2nd Prize: Parmeet Kaur - "AI in Healthcare" 3rd Prize: Devesh Kumar, Ritik Dwivedi, Samayveer Singh - "Robust Semi-Supervised Medical Image Classification: Leveraging Reliable Pseudo-Labels" The winners received certificates from the honorable Director, Professor Binod Kumar Kanaujia, recognizing their outstanding contributions. This event highlighted NIT Jalandhar's commitment to promoting innovation and excellence in technology education.
title: Poster Presentation Event - AI Pathways: Exploring Cross-Domain Innovations

desc: On 21st October 2024, 3 faculty members and 53 students from NIT Jalandhar had the opportunity to attend the "Choose France Tour" event organized by Campus France at Chandigarh. Faculty and students from our institute actively participated in the event, which featured discussions, presentations, and networking opportunities with various French universities. Approximately 40 French universities participated, including 4 public universities, 14 engineering schools, and 18 management universities. The event saw representation from prominent Indian institutions, including IIT Ropar, IISER Mohali, Punjab University, Chandigarh, etc. The NIT Jalandhar delegation found the event highly informative and engaging. Faculty members were able to explore potential collaborations in research and student exchange. The networking event allowed our faculty to engage in meaningful conversations with representatives from French institutions, laying the groundwork for future partnerships. Several universities showed significant interest in establishing collaborations with NIT Jalandhar. Discussions centered around signing MOUs and initiating student exchange programs for internships and full-year study opportunities. Various fellowship schemes, programs, and courses were presented to the attending students.

National Wellbeing Conclave (NWC-2024) organized by Ministry of Education and IIT Hyderabad
title: National Wellbeing Conclave (NWC-2024) organized by Ministry of Education and IIT Hyderabad
desc: IIT Hyderabad has organized "National Wellbeing Conclave (NWC-2024)" under the aegis of The Ministry of Education, Government of India for Higher Education Institutions as the first NWC in India on a grand scale from November 9-10, 2024. Shri K. Sanjay Murthy, Hon’ble Secretary, Ministry of Education, Government of India was the Chief Guest of the event. The aim of the conclave is to foster healthy and harmonious environment in higher education institutions with the goal of reducing suicide rates and enhancing student and faculty wellbeing. One faculty and two students from NIT Jalandhar had the opportunity to join NWC-2024. However, Over 500 participants from 100 centrally funded institutions have attended the event at IIT Hyderabad. The two-day conclave features discussions about best practices on wellbeing in campuses with participation of institutions of India. The NWC also aligns with the Economic Survey 2023-24 which highlights the need for mental health programmes within educational institutions.
title: National Wellbeing Conclave (NWC-2024) organized by Ministry of Education and IIT Hyderabad

text:
National Wellbeing Conclave (NWC-2024) organized by Ministry of Education and IIT Hyderabad
During the inaugural speech, Shri K. Sanjay Murthy, Hon’ble Secretary of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, appreciated the pioneering initiative taken by the worthy Director of NIT Jalandhar, Prof. Binod K. Kanaujia to start a BTech-MBA dual degree program. This program integrates technical and management education to provide students with a comprehensive skill set. This unique approach has the potential to equip students with the tools necessary to achieve both academic excellence and professional success in an ever-evolving global job market. The interactions with the delegates from the Ministry of Education and other institutions during the event was helpful for collaboration among institutions across the country. The essential foundation, through deliberations on mental health and resilience initiatives, is for spreading effective practices across the country and for future initiatives.
title: National Wellbeing Conclave (NWC-2024) organized by Ministry of Education and IIT Hyderabad

In support of the Digital India initiative, NIT Jalandhar has digitized degree certificates through DigiLocker and provided perpetual access to electronic textbooks alongside establishing an e-library with a seating capacity of 400. The Institute has actively implemented the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 from 2023, revising BTech and MTech curriculum for interdisciplinary learning. Prof Kanaujia highlighted that as a recent achievement, the institute now stands in the ranking band of 661-680 in the prestigious QS World rankings among Asian Universities, and is at the 202nd position among Southern Asia Universities. The success of the institute has been driven by significant progress in the field of research. The Institute’s faculty have excelled in research, publishing 958 articles in prestigious international journals in 2024, contributing to a total of 7,325 publications since its inception. The institute introduced a new IPR policy, resulting in 103 published and eight granted IPRs from 2020 to 2024. Faculty members have also secured 87 externally sponsored projects worth Rs. 40 Crores.

title: Press Tour of Media Delegates (Andhra Pradesh) and PIB Officials of Vijayawada at NITJ on 6th December 2024
desc: NIT Jalandhar hosted an interactive session with media delegates from the Press Information Bureau (PIB), Andhra Pradesh, as part of their press tour to Punjab organized by PIB Andhra Pradesh under the aegis of the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, Government of India. The tour aimed to enhance public awareness and participation in government policies, promoting better governance. The delegates’ visit to NIT Jalandhar centred on discussions about the implementation of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, highlighting its impact and progress. The delegation included two officers from PIB Andhra Pradesh and approximately ten journalists, led by Sh Rajendra Chaudhary, the Additional Director General of PIB Vijaywada. The event was attended by Prof Ajay Bansal (Registrar, NIT Jalandhar), Prof Raman Bedi (Dean Academics), Prof Anish Sachdeva (Dean Student Welfare), Prof Rohit Mehra (Dean Research and Consultancy), Prof Subhas Chander (Dean Planning and Development), Prof Mamta Khosla (Dean Industry and International Affairs) and other faculty members of the Institute.
title: Press Tour of Media Delegates (Andhra Pradesh) and PIB Officials of Vijayawada at NITJ on 6th December 2024

text:
Press Tour of Media Delegates (Andhra Pradesh) and PIB Officials of Vijayawada at NITJ on 6th December 2024
The interaction session commenced with a welcome note from Prof Ajay Bansal, Registrar, who highlighted the role of media in shaping the nation’s future. He further laid down the glory of Punjab’s cultural heritage and the importance of inculcating values from different cultural backgrounds of the nation. He highlighted the recent achievements of NIT Jalandhar in the past year. The Institute has achieved an impressive ranking band of 661-680 in the QS World University Rankings Asia 2025. The Institute’s faculty have excelled in research by publishing papers in renowned journals and bagging funding worth crores. The Institute has also got a funding of Rs 240 crores for infrastructure development under HEFA. The media delegates were felicitated by the faculty members of the Institute. Industrial Visit of Electrical Engineering Students to Ganguwal Power Station and Bhakra Nangal Dam
title: Industrial Visit of Electrical Engineering Students to Ganguwal Power Station and Bhakra Nangal Dam
desc: The second year Electrical Engineering students visited the Ganguwal Power Station and Bhakra Nangal Dam on 26th April 2025. The students were accompanied by the faculty members Dr. Harimurugan, Dr. B. N. Rao, and Dr. Nibha Rani. The visit provided students with valuable insights into the working of hydroelectric power generation systems. Engineers at the site explained the operational mechanisms of turbines, generators, and the overall energy conversion process. Students also had the opportunity to understand the significance of the Bhakra Nangal Dam in India’s power infrastructure, including water regulation, flood control, and irrigation. A special session was dedicated to the historical background of the Bhakra project, detailing its conception, construction, and its role in nation-building post-independence. Furthermore, students learned about the transmission and distribution systems associated with the power generated at the dam. Experts discussed the various substations connected to different powerhouses under the Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB), and how power is routed across states in northern India.
title: Industrial Visit of Electrical Engineering Students to Ganguwal Power Station and Bhakra Nangal Dam

The event aimed to inspire students by showcasing various facts of life in the IAF, including a flight simulator, VR set, aircraft models, flying clothing, and other youth-oriented gadgets. Students also explored the thrill of flying through the simulator, adding an exciting hands-on dimension to the experience. text:
Aarogya Club Launches 'NITJ का अपना Blood Bank Platform' - A Student-Driven Initiative
title: Aarogya Club Launches 'NITJ का अपना Blood Bank Platform' - A Student-Driven Initiative
desc: The Aarogya Club of NIT Jalandhar has launched NITJ का अपना Blood Bank Platform, a first-of-its-kind, student-driven initiative to provide timely, transparent, and trustworthy support during blood emergencies. In moments of crisis, families often struggle through informal WhatsApp groups to find donors—facing delays, lack of trust, and no structured system. To solve this, Aarogya Club has created a dedicated platform where blood requests can be raised instantly and fulfilled by verified student donors. This initiative has been developed under the visionary leadership of Prof. Binod Kumar Kanaujia (Director, NITJ), Prof. Ajay Bansal (Registrar), Prof. Rohit Mehra (Dean, Research & Consultancy), and Prof. Anish Kumar Sachdeva (Dean, Student Welfare), with the guidance and support of Dr. Tarun Sehgal (Medical Officer & Faculty Coordinator, Aarogya Club) and Dr. Ravi Verma (Faculty Coordinator, Aarogya Club). How it Works: Anyone in need can submit a request through the official Blood Request Form. Aarogya Club contacts matching registered donors from the NITJ community. Verified student donors step up to ensure timely support.
title: Aarogya Club Launches 'NITJ का अपना Blood Bank Platform' - A Student-Driven Initiative

text:
Aarogya Club Launches 'NITJ का अपना Blood Bank Platform' - A Student-Driven Initiative
Why This Matters: No more uncertainty or delays during critical hours. A platform built on trust, responsibility, and solidarity. A chance for every student to contribute directly to saving lives. Vision Ahead: Currently, the platform serves the NITJ community, but this is just the beginning. Aarogya Club aims to scale the initiative into a pan-India student donor network, uniting institutes nationwide in the spirit of compassion and service. By joining as a Blood Ally, students do more than volunteer—they become lifelines in emergencies. Together, the NITJ community is building a culture of care, trust, and solidarity. Explore here: aarogyanitj.in/bloodbank For further details, please contact Aarogya Club, NITJ.

title: Khelo India Samvaad - Khel Ki Baat PM Ke Saath
desc: NIT Jalandhar hosted ‘Khelo India Samvaad - Khel Ki Baat PM Ke Saath’ on 27 August 2026 under the aegis of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India. The programme brought together students and young participants for an engaging session centred around sports, fitness and the importance of maintaining an active lifestyle. One of the key moments of the programme was the virtual interaction of Hon’ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi with the youth of the country, including students of NIT Jalandhar . The Prime Minister spoke about the role of sports and fitness in the overall development of young people and encouraged them to actively participate in sporting activities and nurture their talent. The event was graced by Padma Shri Harbhajan Singh , former Indian international cricketer and World Cup champion, as the Chief Guest. Interacting with students, he spoke about his sporting journey and shared his experiences of the dedication, hard work and discipline that go into building a career in sports.
title: Khelo India Samvaad - Khel Ki Baat PM Ke Saath

text:
Khelo India Samvaad - Khel Ki Baat PM Ke Saath
The programme also featured Ms. Manya Ralhan, accomplished international badminton player and promising young sporting talent . Her presence added to the interaction and gave students an opportunity to hear from a young athlete pursuing her journey in competitive badminton. The programme was attended by senior Institute officials, faculty members, officers, staff and students and also set the stage for National Sports Day on 28 August , commemorating the legacy of legendary hockey player Major Dhyan Chand . A day of sports, interaction and learning at NIT Jalandhar.
title: Khelo India Samvaad - Khel Ki Baat PM Ke Saath

text:
NITJAA Alumni Networking Event 2026
title: NITJAA Alumni Networking Event 2026
desc: The NIT Jalandhar Alumni Association (NITJAA) Local Chapter successfully hosted an Alumni Networking Event on 20 September 2026 at Hotel Hometel by Sarovar, Chandigarh. The event brought together alumni from diverse batches and branches, providing a vibrant platform to reconnect, exchange experiences and strengthen the enduring NITJ alumni community. The programme featured a lively blend of informal and nostalgic activities, including Yaaron Ki Antakshari, NITJ Charades and a specially curated nostalgia video, which rekindled cherished memories of campus life and created an atmosphere of friendship and camaraderie. These activities were complemented by a structured networking session across batches, enabling alumni to interact with one another, share professional journeys, explore opportunities for collaboration and build new connections. The event witnessed an inspiring participation of nearly 70 alumni representing batches from 1989 to 2020, reflecting the enduring strength and timelessness of the NITJ bond.
title: NITJAA Alumni Networking Event 2026

text:
NITJAA Alumni Networking Event 2026
Adding to the vibrancy of the gathering, nearly 10 current students from SARC also joined the celebrations, creating a meaningful bridge between the institute’s rich legacy and its promising future. Their presence enriched the interactions, encouraged intergenerational exchange and made the event even more inclusive and memorable. The enthusiastic participation and spirited interaction throughout the event made it a highly successful and memorable gathering, reaffirming the strong bonds that unite the NITJ fraternity and embodying the timeless spirit of “Once an NITian, Always an NITian.”
title: NITJAA Alumni Networking Event 2026

NIT Jalandhar Ranked 52nd in NIRF Ranking-2022
title: NIT Jalandhar Ranked 52nd in NIRF Ranking-2022
desc: Dear Faculty Members, Staff, Students and Alumni, Greetings!!!! I am extremely delighted to share the remarkable achievement of NITJ in getting ranked in the highly prestigious Indian ranking "NIRF-2022" released on 15 July, 2022. NIT Jalandhar has been ranked 52nd in "Engineering Ranking" and 85th in "Overall Ranking" amongst the Indian universities/institutes. As a result of improvement in all fields of academia as per NIRF parameters such as: TLR RPC GO OI Perception I acknowledge and appreciate the continuous efforts of learned Faculty members, Staff, Students, and Alumni for this achievement. I hope this growth will continue further with everyone's efforts. Prof. Binod Kumar Kanaujia Director Dr B R Ambedkar National Institute of Technology Jalandhar
title: NIT Jalandhar Ranked 52nd in NIRF Ranking-2022

text:
Instructions for Fee Payment and Semester Registration
For any Technical Difficulty, Contact at Email: webmaster@nitj.ac.in Important Instructions: All B.Tech. students who want to claim a waiver of the Tuition Fee shall be required to submit the latest Income Certificate issued by the appropriate authority on or after 01.04.2023 (The option to Upload Income Certificate is available in the Fee Portal ) The Students studying through Education Loan have to upload the Letter issued by the Concerned Bank Branch Manager as per the format/instructions mentioned in the Fee Structure. (The option to Upload Bank Letter is available in the Registration Portal ) The Students who are studying through Education Loan, If also claiming Tuition Fee waiver based on Income, they have to merge the Bank Letter and Income Certificate into a Single PDF file and upload on the Registration Portal. Don't use the direct link of any Bank for Semester Fee Payment, Fee must be paid only through NITJ Fee Portal. Payment through Demand Draft / Internet Transfer directly to the Institute account will not be entertained.
title: Instructions for Fee Payment and Semester Registration

text:
Instructions for Fee Payment and Semester Registration
After Successful Transaction, Download PDF of e-Receipt from NITJ Fee Portal. During Fee Payment, If the amount is debited from your bank account, and Fee Status has not been updated on the NITJ Fee Portal. You can contact at email: webmaster@nitj.ac.in Note: If you are using Debit/Credit Card for Fee Payment, Transaction Failure may be occurred due to the following reason: Your Card has a restriction on the maximum amount you can withdraw at a time. In this case, Please use the following option(s): Option 1: Use NetBanking Option 2: Use Another Card that has a withdrawal limit more than the amount to be paid. Option 3: You can also make payment through Challan, For this, please follow the below steps: 1. Login to NITJ Fee Portal, Select ICICI payment gateway. 2. In the Next Screen, click on Make Payment Button. 3. In the Next Screen, Select NEFT/RTGS option. 4. Click on Generate Challan Button. 5.

NIT Jalandhar Ranked 46th in NIRF Ranking-2023
title: NIT Jalandhar Ranked 46th in NIRF Ranking-2023
desc: NIT Jalandhar has once again secured a rank in the top 50 engineering institutions in the NIRF ranking released on 05, June 2023. The institute has secured 46th position in “Engineering Category” and 72nd position in “Overall ranking” of NIRF ranking, 2023. In another ranking released on the same day, i.e., ARIIA (Innovation) ranking 2023 , NIT Jalandhar has been placed in a ranking band of 11-50 , which is another remarkable achievement for the institute. We are driving our best efforts to further improve in each parameter. I always welcome your valuable suggestions in this never-ending journey of success and excellence. I acknowledge and appreciate continuous support of Ministry of Education and valuable suggestions of our stakeholders for this year's achievement in the all-India NIRF ranking-2023. I hope this growth will continue further with everyone's support in the development of our institute and nation. Jai Hind Jai Bharat!!!! Prof. Binod Kumar Kanaujia Director Dr B R Ambedkar National Institute of Technology Jalandhar
title: NIT Jalandhar Ranked 46th in NIRF Ranking-2023

desc: NITJ is pleased to offer summer internship for both Internal (NITJ students) and External candidates., Student will have to pay a fee of RS 5000/- for this internship. The steps to apply for the internship are as below: a) Explore the opportunity available by clicking the following link: Details of Summer Internship 2025 b) Download and fill the application form by clicking the following link: Guidelines and Application form for Summer Internship c) Get the application form signed from your college. d) Pay the internship fee of Rs 5000/- by clicking the following link: Fee Payment Link e) Combine all documents listed in steps 2 to 4 (as mentioned in the guidelines) into a single PDF file. Ensure that the application form, along with the transaction slip, is included. Make sure the PDF file size does not exceed 10 MB. Email the PDF to internships@nitj.ac.in with a copy (CC) sent to the concerned faculty and the respective head of the department.

NIT Jalandhar Faculty Members have been listed among the Best Scientists in the World as per survey conducted by Research.com
title: NIT Jalandhar Faculty Members have been listed among the Best Scientists in the World as per survey conducted by Research.com
desc: Two Faculty Members from the Dr B R Ambedkar National Institute of Technology (NIT) Jalandhar, Prof Balbir Singh Kaith and Prof Vishal S Sharma, have been listed among the Best Scientists in the world as per the survey conducted by Research.com, a renowned global research and analysis platform. Prof Balbir Singh Kaith secured the top position from the Institute in the Material Science domain, while Prof Vishal S Sharma was the best among the Engineering and Technology domain. This achievement adds to their earlier recognition of appearing among the Top 2% Scientists of the World by a study published by Stanford University, US during the Year 2019-20, 2020-21 and 2021-22. On this occasion, Prof Binod Kumar Kanaujia, Director of the Institute, congratulated and appreciated the Faculty Members for their outstanding contributions to their respective domains. He emphasized that the recognition was a testament to the dedication and hard work of the Faculty Members towards their research and academics.
title: NIT Jalandhar Faculty Members have been listed among the Best Scientists in the World as per survey conducted by Research.com

BTech students of NIT Jalandhar can enrol for these courses at very nominal fee offered specially under the MOU. It is envisaged further that these courses will be offered under the credit framework of the UG program of the institute in line with the broad objectives of NEP. Key Benefits: - Interdisciplinary Learning: BTech students will gain insights into management principles and practices, preparing them for leadership roles. - Industry-Relevant Curriculum: ISB's courses will help NITJ students stay updated with the latest industry trends and best practices. - Career Opportunities: The collaboration will open up new career paths for NITJ students in management and leadership roles.
title: MoU signed between NIT Jalandhar and Indian School of Business (ISB) Hyderabad

title: MoU signed between NIT Jalandhar and Unati Agri Allied and Marketing Multistate Cooperative Society Ltd.
desc: Dr B R Ambedkar National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with The Unati Agri Allied and Marketing Multistate Cooperative Society Ltd. on September 12, 2025. The Unati Agri Allied and Marketing Multistate Cooperative Society Ltd. (UAMMCL) , a cooperative society registered under the Multistate Cooperative Societies Act, 2002, with a presence across five Indian states—Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Jammu & Kashmir UT. UAMMCL has extensive experience in mass livelihood generation, women empowerment, and value addition of natural bio-resources. It has notably built a robust supply chain in jaggery and sugarcane, and has been instrumental in training farmers in scientific jaggery production methods for quality enhancement and market expansion. The Parties share a common goal of empowering rural communities through technological interventions, sustainable agriculture, innovation, and institutional strengthening. The Parties recognize the need for concerted efforts in capacity building, knowledge dissemination, and transfer of affordable technologies for rural transformation.
title: MoU signed between NIT Jalandhar and Unati Agri Allied and Marketing Multistate Cooperative Society Ltd.

Dr. D. Harimurugan appointed as Associate Editor of the IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement (IEEE TIM)
title: Dr. D. Harimurugan appointed as Associate Editor of the IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement (IEEE TIM)
desc: NIT Jalandhar extends its heartfelt congratulations to Dr. Harimurugan Devarajan , Assistant Professor (Grade-I), Department of Electrical Engineering, on his appointment as Associate Editor of the IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement (IEEE TIM) . IEEE TIM is widely recognised as the leading journal in the field of Instrumentation and Measurement , holding the highest Impact Factor in the general I&M domain and ranked in Q1 in both the Instruments & Instrumentation category and the Electrical & Electronic Engineering (EEE) category of the Journal Citation Reports (JCR) . As a flagship publication of the IEEE Instrumentation and Measurement Society, the journal is renowned for its rigorous peer-review standards and its significant influence on global research in measurement science, sensing technologies, intelligent instrumentation, and advanced signal processing. Dr. Harimurugan’s inclusion on the editorial board of such a distinguished IEEE journal is a matter of great pride for the institute and reflects NIT Jalandhar’s growing stature in high-quality research and academic leadership.
title: Dr. D. Harimurugan appointed as Associate Editor of the IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement (IEEE TIM)

Ashish Bhan (Batch of 1995: ECE)
name: Ashish Bhan (Batch of 1995: ECE)
messageText: I will always cherish the time, the learnings, and the relationships I have build at this great institute called NIT Jalandhar. I could not have achieved what i have today without NITJ's contribution in my life.
designation: Managing Director, Accenture Technology
title: Ashish Bhan (Batch of 1995: ECE)

M R S Sastry (Batch of 1995: ICE)
name: M R S Sastry (Batch of 1995: ICE)
messageText: I always cherish the days spent in REC Jalandhar. The period spend in college transformed me from an ignorant person to a person with good knowledge and additional skills.

title: M R S Sastry (Batch of 1995: ICE)

text:
Jagdeep Chawla (Batch of 1994: Textile Technology)
name: Jagdeep Chawla (Batch of 1994: Textile Technology)
messageText: It is with great pleasure that I commend the institution from which I received my undergraduate degree 28 years ago. The academic rigor and scholarly excellence provided by faculty were exceptional.
designation: Director, eNest Technologies Private Limited, Mohali
title: Jagdeep Chawla (Batch of 1994: Textile Technology)

text:
Ramanpreet Singh (1995: Chemical & Bio Engineering)
name: Ramanpreet Singh (1995: Chemical & Bio Engineering)
messageText: NITJ has played an outsized role in shaping and moulding the lives of people who call it their alma mater, and I am no exception. It is heartening to see it blossom into an institution of great reputation.
designation: Director, Product Marketing Management, AT&T Services, Dallas, US
title: Ramanpreet Singh (1995: Chemical & Bio Engineering)

text:
Tanmay Mukherji (Batch of 1996: Industrial Engineering)
name: Tanmay Mukherji (Batch of 1996: Industrial Engineering)
messageText: My four years at the erstwhile REC Jalandhar were the formative years of my life and career. I feel everyone needs to open their horizons and not shy away from any opportunity to learn new things.
designation: CEO, Zeta Innovation Labs
title: Tanmay Mukherji (Batch of 1996: Industrial Engineering)

text:
Nalin Chakoo (Batch of 2006: CSE)
name: Nalin Chakoo (Batch of 2006: CSE)
messageText: Embrace the opportunity to make meaningful memories and experiences at NITJ as those will be with you for a lifetime. Follow your heart, take chances to be the best, and prepare yourself to become pioneers of change.
designation: Director, Amazon Seattle (Former Director, Samsung Research America)
title: Nalin Chakoo (Batch of 2006: CSE)

text:
Pranab K. Sharma (Batch of 1996: Mech)
name: Pranab K. Sharma (Batch of 1996: Mech)
messageText: It's heartening to see how REC Jalandhar have matured into NITJ, an institute of national importance with a sprawling campus and competent faculty members which bears the testimony.
designation: Portfolio Construction Manager, Shell Technology Centre, Bangalore
title: Pranab K. Sharma (Batch of 1996: Mech)

text:
Mr Preminder Singh (Batch of 1994: ECE)
name: Mr Preminder Singh (Batch of 1994: ECE)
messageText: Preminder is a seasoned Product Engineering Director with extensive experience in the semiconductor industry, specializing in the development and shipping of Apple System-on-Chips (SoCs). With over 20+ years of experience, he has a proven track record of leading cross-functional teams to deliver cutting-edge technology on time and within budget. His expertise encompasses product development, design validation, and manufacturing processes, ensuring high-quality standards and performance benchmarks are met. Preminder has a strong background in collaborative problem-solving, driving innovation, and optimizing workflows to enhance productivity. Passionate about technology and engineering excellence, he is committed to fostering a culture of continuous improvement and mentorship within his teams.
designation: Director, Product Engineering @APPLE, US
title: Mr Preminder Singh (Batch of 1994: ECE)

Within social change, it drives individuals to recognize and address societal issues, promoting justice and progress. In personal development, Chetna encourages self-awareness and growth, helping individuals make informed decisions and lead fulfilling lives. By embracing Chetna, people can achieve greater clarity, compassion, and effectiveness in their personal and collective endeavors, thereby transforming their lives and communities.

description: Google Developer Student Clubs (GDSC) NIT Jalandhar is a vibrant community of tech enthusiasts and aspiring developers at the National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar. As part of the global GDSC network, our chapter is dedicated to fostering innovation, collaboration, and learning in various fields of technology. We organize workshops, hackathons, and interactive sessions with industry experts to bridge the gap between academic knowledge and real-world applications. Our focus areas include but are not limited to artificial intelligence, web development, mobile app development, and cloud computing. By leveraging Google technologies and resources, we aim to empower students with practical skills, encourage peer-to-peer learning, and nurture a culture of problem-solving. GDSC NIT Jalandhar serves as a platform for students to explore their passion for technology, work on meaningful projects, and prepare for successful careers in the ever-evolving tech industry.

name: videography
clubName: Photography and Movie Club
description: The Photography Club (Netra) and Movie Club (Deja Vu) at NIT Jalandhar are the two dynamic and inclusive community of students dedicated to celebrating the art of cinema and Photography. We are united by our love for films, photos, cinema, visual arts and the desire to explore the diverse spectrum of cinematic experiences that our lens has to offer. Our club serves as a platform for students to come together, discuss, and appreciate the rich tapestry of cinema and photography from around the globe. Join us and embark on a cinematic journey like no other. Whether you're an ardent film lover, a photography enthusiast, an aspiring director, or simply curious about the world of cameras, there's a place for you in our club. Together, we'll explore the realms of storytelling, culture, and artistry through the lens of our camera. So, grab your popcorn, open your mind, and prepare to be transported to worlds both familiar and uncharted.

message: Welcome to the Department of Biotechnology at Dr. B. R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar. The Institute has ranked 46 in the 2023 NIRF ranking of Engineering. The Department was established in 2007 with an intake of thirty in B.Tech and was grown over the years to the present intake of fifty-eight. The department also has the Ph.D. program. Since its inception, the department has made several strategic changes in the curriculum to prepare students for vibrant and dynamic workplace challenges. The department started M.Tech programmes in Biotechnology in 2019. The National Board of Accreditation (NBA) accredits the B.Tech programme offered by the department continuously from July 2016 to June 2025. The department is well equipped with B.Tech, M.Tech. and research laboratories which are also supported by TEQIP (World Bank) and Institute Funds from the Government of India. The B.Tech, M.Tech, and Ph.D. students are encouraged to work on various industry-oriented research projects.
title: Prof. Asim K. Jana

text:
Prof. Asim K. Jana
Our vision is to achieve excellence by providing the best facility in the entire spectrum of Biotechnology education, research, and consultancy. The Faculty members of the department have excellent academic and research credentials with good expertise in the diverse field of Biotechnology. The credential of the B.Tech syllabus is well established by the excellent GATE ranking the B.Tech students from this Department had achieved over the years. We had B.Tech. Alumni scored GATE rank 2 for three years in 2012, 2016, and 2019. In the year 2023, also our B.Tech students achieved the GATE rank of 4. Alumni of the department have been conferred with many prestigious awards and are serving globally in the USA, Canada, Europe, Australia, and Singapore in academia as well as industry. The department also has foreign research collaborations with the University Of Florence, Italy. We take pride in the achievements of our students and firmly believe in their attitude toward excellence and to make a significant impact globally in the field of Biotechnology.

description: Established in the year 1990, The Department of Civil Engineering holds the distinction of being the oldest among the 12 departments at Dr. B R Ambedkar NIT Jalandhar. Over the years, it has evolved into a distinguished center for excellence, fostering innovation and conducting impactful research. The department boasts a dedicated faculty and staff, highly motivated students, and an environment that promotes innovative teaching and learning. The department offers a range of academic programs, including the undergraduate program B. Tech in Civil Engineering, postgraduate programs such as M. Tech in Geotechnical & Geo-environmental Engineering, and Structural & Construction Engineering. In addition, the department also offers Ph.D. programs to cater to the research aspirations of its students. Department of Civil Engineering at Dr. B R Ambedkar NIT Jalandhar has established itself as a prominent institution, equipping students with the necessary skills and knowledge to succeed in the field of civil engineering.

Our focus is on strengthening academic programmes through outcome-based education, promoting interdisciplinary and industry-linked research and encouraging experiential learning. With the continued support of faculty, staff, students, alumni and industry partners, we aim to advance excellence, uphold our proud legacy and contribute meaningfully to the development of resilient and sustainable infrastructure.

text:
dept cee description
description: Centre for Energy and Environment is devoted to advancing research, education, and community outreach in the fields of energy and environmental science. Our primary focus is on developing innovative solutions to address global challenges related to sustainable energy production, environmental protection, and climate change mitigation. Our mission is to encourage interdisciplinary collaboration among researchers, students, and professionals across various domains. By integrating knowledge from engineering, science, policy, and economics, we strive to conduct impactful research and promote the widespread adoption of clean, efficient energy technologies. Centre leads cutting-edge research in diverse areas, including renewable energy sources, energy storage systems, electric vehicles, sustainable buildings, energy efficiency, and environmental policy analysis. We maintain strong partnerships with Industry stakeholders, Government agencies, and International organizations to develop practical solutions that create meaningful societal benefits. Since 2020, we have been offering the M.Tech program in Renewable Energy in collaboration with the Sardar Swaran Singh National Institute of Bio-Energy (SSS-NIBE), Kapurthala(MNRE, GOI).
title: dept cee description

text:
dept cee description
This program benefits from the combined expertise of NIT Jalandhar faculty and SSS-NIBE scientists, offering students a rich academic and research experience. Our curriculum blends theoretical instruction with practical applications, encouraging students to participate in research projects, internships, and fieldwork. This approach prepares them to become future leaders in the energy and environmental sectors.

message: The Centre for Energy and Environment at Dr. B. R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar, was established in 2020 with a dedicated focus on research in Renewable Energy and sustainability. That same year, the M.Tech program in Renewable Energy was launched in collaboration with Sardar Swaran Singh National Institute of Bio-Energy, Kapurthala (MNRE, Government of India). Building on this foundation, the PhD program commenced in 2021 to further enhance education and research in sustainable development technologies. The Centre is committed to equipping students with the technical expertise and forward-thinking mindset needed to tackle global energy and environmental challenges. The M.Tech program in Renewable Energy encompasses a wide array of subjects, including Solar (Photovoltaic and Thermal), Hydro and Wind Energy, Bioenergy, Green Hydrogen, Electric Vehicles, and Green Buildings. We promote innovation through experiential learning, industry partnerships, and interdisciplinary research. As you embark on your journey with us, we invite you to explore new ideas, drive innovation, and make meaningful contributions to a sustainable future.

message: Welcome to the Department of Chemical Engineering at Dr. B. R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar. The Department was established in 1990 with an intake of thirty undergraduate students and grown marvelously over the years. Since its inception, the department has made several strategic changes in the curriculum to prepare students for tomorrow's workplace challenges. Currently, the undergraduate students capacity has been boosted to 90. The department commenced M.Tech and PhD programmes in Chemical Engineering in 2006.The course curriculums are periodically updated for introducing new and innovative technology so as to nurture a new generation of technical leaders who can offer holistic solutions to complex problems at the intersection of technology and society. B.Tech programme offered by the department is accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA).

message: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering was established and first batch was started with an intake of 40 students in the academic year 1990. The department offers two undergraduate Programs, B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering with an intake of 158 students and B.Tech in Data Science and Engineering with an intake of 60. The department started PG/Ph.D. programs in the academic year of 2006. At Present, the department is offering three PG programs: M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, Data Science and Engineering and Computer Engineering Science and Engineering (Information Security). Further, the Department also offers few seats in PG programs (self-sponsored) on the basis of institute level entrance examination conducted in the month of May/June. The thrust Areas of research in the department are Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, Cloud Computing, Machin/Deep learning, Image processing, Internet of things, scientific computing and information security. Department has a dedicated team of 32 faculty members with specialization in various thrust areas.

dept cw description
description: In this dynamic world, Technology plays a significant role in the learning. It is an established fact that one can have a strong grip on the concept of science and technology by seeking logic and reasoning behind them rather than just mugging them up. The youth of today is brimming with curiosity and inquisitiveness. They are perpetually on the move. The rapid pace of technological advancement has made it imperative for us to be well informed in the global scenario. Each day in our life dawns with new challenges to be faced. One needs to be geared up to face these challenges with determination, righteousness and well directed thoughts. All these geared mechanisms are boosted only with the help of practical aspects which are only and only possible on the floor of “workshop” A workshop is an informative or instructional class focused on teaching specialized skill or exploring a particular subject.
title: dept cw description

Dr Dushyant Singh
department: cw
name: Dr Dushyant Singh
email: hws@nitj.ac.in
position: Associate Professor
message: The Central Workshop has been an integral part of the Institute since its inception, providing essential technical support to academic and research activities across various departments. Over the years, the workshop has continuously upgraded its facilities and expertise to meet the evolving demands of modern engineering education and research. The Central Workshop plays a vital role in imparting practical training to undergraduate and postgraduate students by bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and hands-on experience. It supports laboratory courses, project work, fabrication activities, and research experimentation. Students are trained in various manufacturing processes, machining operations, welding, fitting, carpentry, and other core engineering practices to develop their technical competence and professional skills. Equipped with advanced and state-of-the-art machinery, the workshop caters to the fabrication and development needs of student projects, sponsored research work, and consultancy assignments. The facility is continuously modernized to incorporate emerging technologies and ensure high standards of precision, safety, and efficiency.
title: Dr Dushyant Singh

text:
Dr Dushyant Singh
The workshop staff consists of skilled technical personnel who provide guidance and supervision, ensuring quality workmanship and adherence to safety protocols. The Central Workshop also supports interdisciplinary research initiatives and collaborative projects within the Institute. This webpage provides information about the workshop facilities, available machinery, training programs, operational guidelines, and contact details. We hope students, researchers, faculty members, and visitors find this platform informative and useful. The Central Workshop remains committed to supporting innovation, creativity, and technological advancement at NIT Jalandhar. Thank you for visiting us.
phone: +91-0181-5037926

mission:

- To facilitate fabrication, prototyping, and research activities by offering modern machinery, technical expertise, and continuous skill development support.

description: About Department of Chemistry: The Department of Chemistry NIT- Jalandhar is one of the Seventeen Departments of the Institute. The coherent, cohesive and homely environment of the Department is attributed to the students, faculty and staff with tremendous potential and opportunities to grow academically, socially, emotionally and spiritually. The Department started functioning in 1989 for teaching undergraduate (B Tech) students. M Sc and Ph D Programs were initiated in July 2006. Department is striving to emerge as a premier Centre of Chemistry teaching and research of the country. Within a span of seventeen years of commencement of post graduate classes, the Department has achieved results which reflect upon the growth pattern of the Department. The Department has organized several International and National Conferences, Short Term Courses to grow the academic collaborations and to give exposure to our students. The Department has also been selected as 'DST-FIST' sponsored Department.

message: Welcome to the Department of Chemistry! It is a privilege to lead Department of Chemistry of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology (NIT) Jalandhar, one of the national accolades and an outstanding institution of higher learning. NIT Jalandhar is ranked 49th in the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF), Band-Excellent in the Atal Ranking of Institutions on Innovation Achievements (ARIIA), and was recently ranked in the 401-500 range in the Times Higher Education (THE) Emerging Economies University Rankings 2022. Chemistry Department is committed to providing a world-class education and research experience. We offer a vibrant program M Sc in chemistry, from introductory courses to advanced research opportunities. Our faculty members are renowned experts in their respective fields such as Materials science, Nanotechnology, Supramolecular Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry, Coordination Chemistry, Metal organic Framework, Synthetic Organic Chemistry and Computational Chemistry. We foster a collaborative and supportive learning environment.

dept ece description
description: The Department of Electronics & Communication Engineering, Dr. B. R. Ambedkar National Insitute of Technology, Jalandhar has been offering B.Tech programme in Electronics & Communication Engineering since 1989, M.Tech programme in Electronics & Communication Engineering (Full-Time) since 2006 and M.Tech programme in VLSI Design (Full Time) since 2008. The Department also offers Ph.D. programmes in various specializations, such as Biomedical Engineering, VLSI Design, Nanoelectronics and Communication Systems etc. The Department has presently 19 faculty members with PhD degrees from reputed Institutes. The Department has established state-of-the-art laboratories for B.Tech, M.Tech and Ph.D. research work. The Department has advanced Biomedical Signal Processing and Telemedicine Laboratory, VLSI Design Laboratory, Nanoelectronics Research Lab and Communication System Laboratory with sophisticated research equipment. The department has an advanced VLSI lab sponsored by Ministry of Communication and IT under SMDP-II project. In the VLSI lab Cadance, Mentor graphic, Synopsys, Magma, Coware and Xilinx softwares are available for project/research work.
department: ece
title: dept ece description

Dr Ashish Raman
department: ece
name: Dr Ashish Raman
email: hec@nitj.ac.in
position: Associate Professor & Head
message: Welcome to the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering. We started our journey in the year of 1987. Over the last three decades, we have grown our expertise and proficiency in the core Electronics and Communication Engineering curriculum and research. Our department offers two UG Programs i.e., B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering and B.Tech in Electronics and VLSI Engineering, two PG Programs i.e., M.Tech (VLSI) and M.Tech (SP&ML), and a rigorous PhD programme offering research opportunities in various areas of Electronics and Communication. Our department stands at the forefront of technological advancements, driven by our commitment to excellence and innovation. As you explore our website, you will discover the rich tapestry of opportunities that await students, faculty, researchers, and industry partners. Electronics and Communication Engineering department boasts a talented and dedicated faculty, whose expertise spans a wide array of disciplines, including VLSI, Signal and Image Processing, Communications, RF & Microwave, and more.
title: Dr Ashish Raman

dept ee description
description: The Department of Electrical Engineering commenced its Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech) degree program in 2013. Electrical Engineering is a well-diversified discipline. Many areas of specialization namely Control Systems, Power System, High Voltage, Electric Drives etc. have grown by leaps and bounds and have emerged as full-fledged disciplines in themselves. Training students in all these areas is an uphill and challenging task. Therefore, every effort has been made while developing curricula to ensure full cognizance of all value elements among students. A holistic approach has been adopted while framing curriculum, updating infrastructural facilities and improving coaching methods. The teaching scheme has been enriched by the valuable inputs of experts of respective fields from prestigious institutions / organizations such as IIT Roorkee and IIT Delhi, R&D organizations like CSIO and leading industries of the region. The Department is consolidating its efforts to promote industrial research and consultancy in appropriate areas of Electrical Engineering.

text:
Dr B S Saini
department: ee
name: Dr B S Saini
email: hee@nitj.ac.in
position: Professor
message: It is my privilege to welcome you to the Department of Electrical Engineering. As you begin this important phase of your academic journey, I would like to take this opportunity to provide you with an overview of what you can expect from our department and the opportunities that lie ahead. The field of Electrical Engineering is integral to technological advancement and societal development, encompassing areas such as power generation and distribution, automation, intelligent systems, and emerging digital technologies. Our department is committed to equipping students with the knowledge, skills, and adaptability required to thrive in this dynamic and evolving domain. Our academic programs both UG and PG are carefully structured to ensure a balanced and comprehensive learning experience. In the initial years, you will build a strong foundation in mathematics, physics, and basic engineering concepts.
title: Dr B S Saini

text:
Dr B S Saini
As you progress, you will study core subjects including electrical machines, electric drives, power systems, high voltage, micro and smart grid, control systems, solar PV, electric vehicle, battery management, renewable energy and power electronics, along with emerging areas such as artificial intelligence and data analytics, which are increasingly relevant in modern engineering applications. A key feature of our program is its emphasis on practical learning. The department is supported by well-equipped state of art laboratories that enable students to gain hands-on experience and reinforce theoretical concepts. In addition, students are encouraged to undertake mini-projects, major projects, and industrial training, which provide valuable exposure to real-world engineering challenges. The department actively promotes research and innovation, practical learning, collaborative culture, professional and holistic development. Students have opportunities to participate in research activities under the guidance of faculty members and collaborate on interdisciplinary and industry-sponsored projects. These initiatives are designed to foster analytical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving abilities.
title: Dr B S Saini

text:
Dr B S Saini
To this end, the department organizes workshops, seminars, guest lectures, and skill development programs aimed at enhancing communication, teamwork, leadership, and ethical awareness. We also recognize the importance of developing professional competencies beyond technical knowledge. The department has its own society Society of the Electrical Engineering Department “SEED”. This society plays a vital and dynamic role in enhancing the overall academic, professional, and personal development of students within an engineering institute. It serves as a bridge between classroom learning and real-world application, creating a vibrant technical and collaborative environment. Overall, the Society acts as a catalyst for student growth, complementing formal education and preparing students to meet the challenges of the professional world with confidence and competence. Our goal is to prepare you not only for successful careers in core engineering sectors, software and analytics industries, or higher education and research, but also to become responsible professionals capable of contributing meaningfully to society.
title: Dr B S Saini

text:
Dr B S Saini
I encourage you to actively engage in all academic and co-curricular activities, seek guidance whenever needed, and make the most of the resources available to you. Your dedication and efforts will play a crucial role in shaping your future. I wish you a productive, enriching, and successful academic journey.

Congratulations to Saksham Kaushish, a third-year B.Tech Electrical Engineering student for Felicitation by Dr. Raj Bhushan Choudhary, Minister of State for Jal Shakti, Government of India
department: ee
title: Congratulations to Saksham Kaushish, a third-year B.Tech Electrical Engineering student for Felicitation by Dr. Raj Bhushan Choudhary, Minister of State for Jal Shakti, Government of India
desc: Saksham Kaushish, a third-year B.Tech Electrical Engineering student at NIT Jalandhar, was felicitated by Dr Raj Bhushan Choudhary, Minister of State for Jal Shakti, Government of India, at a ceremony held in New Delhi. The event was also attended by Mark Smith, Director General of the International Water Management Institute (IWMI), along with researchers and staff from IWMI. The recognition follows the duo's Second Prize win in the Youth Innovator Category at the National Water Innovation Hackathon India 2026, organised by IWMI under CGIAR on the theme "Water and Gender." The hackathon was launched on World Water Day and concluded on World Environment Day, attracting applications from young innovators across India. During the event, Saksham presented NadiBot, an AI-powered water grievance redressal platform, and Aqua Alert, an early warning system for flood- and drought-prone districts. Both solutions were developed in collaboration with teammate Samiksha Khaire, an Electrical Engineering student at NIT Jalandhar.
title: Congratulations to Saksham Kaushish, a third-year B.Tech Electrical Engineering student for Felicitation by Dr. Raj Bhushan Choudhary, Minister of State for Jal Shakti, Government of India

dept ice description
description: The Department of Instrumentation and Control Engineering (ICE) commenced its Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) degree programme in 1990 with the intake of 30 students. Initially, the degrees were awarded by Guru Nanak Dev University Amritsar, subsequently, the Institute was affiliated to the newly set-up Punjab Technical University for the period July 1997 through October 2002. The Institute was accorded Deemed University Status w.e.f. October 17, 2002, under the aegis of Ministry of Human Resource Development, New Delhi. Then, the Ministry of Human Resource Development, Government of India has declared the Institute as ―Institute of National Importance under the act of Parliament-2007. Connecting the disciplines of Electrical, Electronics, Mechanics, Computer Science and Control engineering is the core competence of modern engineering. Many areas of specialization namely Process Instrumentation, Control Systems, Biomedical Engineering, Robotic, Wireless Networking etc., equips the Engineers for quick adaptation to new fields of technology and new areas of employment. Training students in all these areas is an uphill and challenging task.
title: dept ice description

text:
dept ice description
ICE curriculum provides a broad insight into state-of-the-art methods for this interdisciplinary combination reinforced by research. Further specialization is realized through the technical electives. Therefore, every effort has been made while developing curricula to ensure full cognizance of all value elements among students. A holistic approach has been adopted while framing curriculum, updating infrastructural facilities and improving coaching methods. The teaching scheme has been enriched by the valuable inputs of experts of respective fields from prestigious institutions / organizations such as IIT Roorkee and IIT Delhi, R&D organizations like CSIO and leading industries of the region. The mission, we follow in our research, teaching and technology is the development of technology for the benefit of mankind. According to this motto, students of many different academic and cultural background study and work together in teams. The teaching of methodology and the logic of engineering – learning to think - is a key aspect of education in the department. This is the way knowledge keeps pace with rapid technological advancements.
title: dept ice description

dept itep description
description: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology Jalandhar, an Institute of National Importance, is among the select institutions chosen by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) to offer the Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP) envisioned under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. This selection reflects the institute's academic excellence, multidisciplinary environment, and strong institutional infrastructure. The Department of Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP) was established in 2023 with the vision of preparing competent, reflective, and socially responsible educators equipped to meet the evolving needs of 21st-century education. The department offers a four-year integrated B.Sc.-B.Ed. programme that combines disciplinary knowledge, pedagogical preparation, and practical teaching experiences to develop future-ready teachers. The programme emphasizes experiential learning, school internships, educational technology, and research-informed practices, fostering professional competence, critical thinking, and a commitment to lifelong learning among future educators.

message: Welcome to the Department of Mathematics and Computing at Dr. B R Ambedkar National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar. Our department brings together pure mathematics and the power of computation to equip students with the skills and mindset needed to solve real-world problems. Whether you're pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate, or doctoral studies, you'll find a supportive academic environment focused on curiosity, innovation, and continuous learning. We are proud to have a dedicated team of faculty members, who are passionate teachers as well as active researchers, working on projects funded by reputed agencies like NBHM, DST, SERB, and ANRF. Our curriculum is designed to blend strong theoretical foundations with practical exposure, preparing students for careers in research, industry, and beyond. What truly makes our department special is the vibrant community of students and scholars who are eager to learn, explore, and grow. We encourage collaboration, ethical practice, and independent thinking in all that we do.

description: The Department of Mechanical engineering was founded in 1990 and has grown as one of the dynamic departments of the Institute over the last three decades. The department is a Govt. of India (FIST)-sponsored department. The department offers B.Tech, M.Tech (Mechanical Systems Engineering) and Ph.D programmes. The B.Tech program is accredited by the NBA. Our alumni are working in reputed organizations such as NTPC, ONGC, IOCL, HAL, BPCL, MARUTI, VOlVO, TATA, ASHOK LEYLAND, etc. Also students have demonstrated a high level of success at pursuing post-graduate and doctoral studies at leading universities world-wide. Many post graduates and Doctorate alumni are working at R&D sector and Faculty at IITs & NITs. Apart from these few are entrepreneur.

text:
Prof Srinivas Tangellapalli
department: me
name: Prof Srinivas Tangellapalli
email: hme@nitj.ac.in; srinivast@nitj.ac.in
position: Professor
message: Welcome to the Department of Mechanical Engineering at NIT Jalandhar. The department started its journey in the year of 1989. Over the last three decades, we have grown our expertise and competence in the core Mechanical Engineering curriculum and research. Department has a strong undergraduate program in mechanical engineering with sanctioned intake of 110 students per year. Department offers M.Tech programme in Mechanical Systems Engineering. At present, the department has around 50 PhD scholars. Several sponsored candidates from industries and research laboratories carry out their postgraduate studies in our department. The primary focus of our curriculum is to impart technical know-how to students, promote their problem solving skills and innovation of new technologies. Department also offers large number of elective courses for providing wide spectrum of options to the students to pursue their interest. The course contents are regularly updated for introducing new scientific and technological developments. Undergraduate students are also encouraged to undertake various research projects.
title: Prof Srinivas Tangellapalli

text:
Prof Srinivas Tangellapalli
Our department maintains active research groups for carrying out collaborative and interdisciplinary research. We have state of the art research facilities to support our academic programs and research. Funding for research (approximately 4 crores during last five years) help us to maintain and modernise our research infrastructure. Our department has a distinguished record in both teaching and research. Faculty members have excellent academic credentials and are highly regarded. Several faculty members serve on the editorial boards of national and international journals, review technical articles for journals on a regular basis, and organize international symposia and conferences. This website provides an overview of the academic programs, research activities of our department, research facilities, profiles of faculty members, and details of student activities. We hope that whether you are a prospective undergraduate or graduate student, or work in industry, or another university, or a visitor, you will find this website to be informative.
title: Prof Srinivas Tangellapalli

Prof Srinivas Tangellapalli
You may correspond with individual faculty members, or contact them by email, using the addresses shown on the faculty pages. Our department looks forward to contribute in solving the technological challenges of the society with active participation from all sections of the society. Thank you for visiting us.

text:
