position. 4. Note 1 (5) of the Statutes states that “for the department which are not having any vacancy, movement in higher academic grade pay or cadre shall be carried out as per specified selection process but it will be restricted to only for serving faculty members of the respective departments.” The matter has been examined in the Bureau, The genesis behind keeping Note 1 (5) in Schedule ‘E’ of amended Statutes is that there are many NITs working with small, peripheral Departments (like Physics, Architecture etc.) having fixed numbers of faculty positions sanctioned by the Board for each of such Department. Any provision in any law / Statute cannot be read in exclusion and must be read in harmony with the entire provision. 5. Note 1 (5) helps NITs to retain their academic talent; however, there may be chances that the same may be used for giving undue advantage, restricting outside faculty from participating in the recruitment process and
title: Annexure-II a Gazette Notification 2017

may be chances that the same may be used for giving undue advantage, restricting outside faculty from participating in the recruitment process and would thus be violative of both letter and spirit of the Act and Statutes. As such, with regard to the application of Note 1 (5) of Schedule ‘E’, it is clarified that excessive reliance on Note 1(5) may lead to dilution of overarching Four- Tier Flexible Faculty Cadre Structure wherein equal opportunity of competition is to be extended to fresh candidates as well as internal candidates. It may lead to dilution in quality of faculty recruitment. 6. (घ) क्रम संख्या 4 के सामने — (i) स्ट्तंभ (2) की प्रजिजियों के स्ट्थान पर जनम्नजलजखत प्रजिजियां रखी िाएंगी, अथाडत्:- "7िें केन्रीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर -13क2 अथिा यथाजस्ट्थजत केन्रीय सरकार अथिा पररषि द्वारा अनुमोदित कोई अन्य समान िेतनमान अथिा िेतन स्ट्तर, में एसोजसएट प्रोफेसर।"; (ii) स्ट्तंभ (4) की प्रजिजियों के स्ट्थान पर जनम्नजलजखत प्रजिजियां रखी िाएंगी, अथाडत्:- “पीएच.डी के बाि छह िषड जिनमें से 7िें केंरीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर -12 या यथाजस्ट्थजत केन्रीय सरकार या पररषि द्वारा अनुमोदित दकसी अन्य संबंजधत िेतनमान या िेतन स्ट्तर, में सहायक प्रोफेसर ग्रेड-I के स्ट्तर पर कम से कम तीन िषड का अनुभि, अथिा दकसी प्रजतजित संस्ट्थान अथिा अनुसंधान और जिकास प्रयोगिाला अथिा संबंजधत उद्योग में समकक्ष; अथिा नौ िषड का कुल कायड अनुभि, जिसमें से तीन िषड पीएच.डी के बाि हों और 7िें केंरीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर -12 में अथिा यथाजस्ट्थजत केन्रीय सरकार अथिा
title: Annexure-II b Gazette Notification 2023

text:
Annexure-II b Gazette Notification 2023
के बाि हों और 7िें केंरीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर -12 में अथिा यथाजस्ट्थजत केन्रीय सरकार अथिा पररषि द्वारा अनुमोदित कोई अन्य समान िेतनमान अथिा िेतन स्ट्तर, में सहायक प्रोफेसर ग्रेड-I के स्ट्तर पर तीन िषड का अनुभि हो अथिा दकसी प्रजतजित संस्ट्थान अथिा अनुसंधान और जिकास प्रयोगिाला अथिा संबंजधत उद्योग में समकक्ष।" (ड.) क्रम संख्या 5 के सामने — (i) स्ट्तंभ (2) की प्रजिजियों के स्ट्थान पर जनम्नजलजखत प्रजिजियां रखी िाएंगी, अथाडत्:- 7िें केन्रीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर -14क या यथाजस्ट्थजत केन्रीय सरकार या पररषि द्वारा अनुमोदित कोई अन्य समान िेतनमान या िेतन स्ट्तर, में प्रोफेसर।" (ii) स्ट्तंभ (4) की प्रजिजियों के स्ट्थान पर जनम्नजलजखत प्रजिजियां रखी िाएंगी, अथाडत्:- [भाग III—खण् ड 4] भारत का रािपत्र : असाधारण 3 “पीएच.डी के बाि िस िषड अथिा तेरह िषड का कुल कायड अनुभि, जिसमें से सात िषड पीएच.डी के बाि होंगे और दकसी प्रजतजित संस्ट्थान अथिा अनुसंधान और जिकास प्रयोगिाला अथिा संबंजधत उद्योग में 7िें केन्रीय िेतन
title: Annexure-II b Gazette Notification 2023

text:
Annexure-II b Gazette Notification 2023
दकसी प्रजतजित संस्ट्थान अथिा अनुसंधान और जिकास प्रयोगिाला अथिा संबंजधत उद्योग में 7िें केन्रीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर -13क2 में एसोजसएट प्रोफेसर के स्ट्तर पर तीन िषड का अनुभि अथिा स्ट्तर - 13क1 में अथिा स्ट्तर 13क1 और स्ट्तर -13क2 अथिा समकक्ष को जमलाकर एसोजसएट प्रोफेसर के स्ट्तर पर चार िषड का अनुभि।" (च) क्रम संख्या 6 के सामने— (i) स्ट्तंभ (2) की प्रजिजियों के स्ट्थान पर जनम्नजलजखत प्रजिजियां रखी िाएंगी, अथाडत्:- "7िें केन्रीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर -15 में अथिा यथाजस्ट्थजत केन्रीय सरकार अथिा पररषि द्वारा अनुमोदित कोई अन्य समान िेतनमान अथिा िेतन स्ट्तर, में प्रोफेसर (उच्च प्रिासजनक ग्रेड)।"; (ii) स्ट्तंभ (4) की प्रजिजियों के स्ट्थान पर जनम्नजलजखत प्रजिजियां रखी िाएंगी,अथाडत्:- "राष्ट्रीय महत्ि के संस्ट्थान में स्ट्तर 14 अथिा समकक्ष अथिा स्ट्तर 14क अथिा समकक्ष अथिा स्ट्तर 14 और स्ट्तर 14क में छह िषड की संयुि सेिा: परन्तु प्रोफेसर के रूप में छह िषड की जनयजमत सेिा करने के पश्चात प्रोफेसर के पिों की कुल संख्या के अजधकतम
title: Annexure-II b Gazette Notification 2023

text:
Annexure-II b Gazette Notification 2023
14क में छह िषड की संयुि सेिा: परन्तु प्रोफेसर के रूप में छह िषड की जनयजमत सेिा करने के पश्चात प्रोफेसर के पिों की कुल संख्या के अजधकतम 40% पिों को पात्रता ितों को पूरा करने के पश्चात और जिजधित गरठत चयन सजमजत की जसफाररिों पर उच् च प्रिासजनक ग्रेड िेतनमान प्रिान दकया िा सकता है।"; (छ) रटप्पण 1 में,— (I) पैरा (1) के स्ट्थान पर जनम्नजलजखत को रखा िाएगा, अथाडत्:- "(1) िेतनमान में दकसी भी पररितडन को, इन पररजनयमों में जििेष रूप से छूट प्राप्त स्ट्थानों को छोडकर, एक खुले जिज्ञापन के माध्यम से और जिजधित गरठत चयन सजमजत की जसफाररिों के आधार पर दकया िाएगा: परन्तु संस्ट्थान में संजििा आधार पर जनयुि सहायक प्रोफेसर ग्रेड-II को जिजधित गरठत चयन सजमजत द्वारा उपयुि पाए िाने पर, दकन्तु खुले जिज्ञापन के माध्यम से न होकर, 7िें केन्रीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर-10 में सफलतापूिडक एक िषड की सेिा पूरी करने पर, 7िें केन्रीय िेतन आयोग के िेतनमान के स्ट्तर-11 अथिा िेतन
title: Annexure-II b Gazette Notification 2023

text:

सफलतापूिडक एक िषड की सेिा पूरी करने पर, 7िें केन्रीय िेतन आयोग के िेतनमान के स्ट्तर-11 अथिा िेतन मैररक्स अथिा अन्य कोई तिनुरूपी िेतनमान या ग्रेड िेतन अथिा िेतन स्ट्तर में स्ट्तरोन्नत दकया िा सकता है। (II) पैरा (6) में, उप-पैरा (क) के स्ट्थान पर, जनम्नजलजखत उप-पैरा को रखा िाएगा, अथाडत्: - "(क) पचास िषड या उससे अजधक आयु िाला स्ट्थायी संकाय- (i) 7िें केन्रीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर-11 में सहायक प्रोफेसर ग्रेड-II को 7िें केन्रीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर-12 में अथिा केन्रीय सरकार या पररषि द्वारा अनुमोदित दकसी अन्य समान िेतनमान अथिा ग्रेड िेतन अथिा िेतन स्ट्तर पर, सहायक प्रोफेसर ग्रेड-I के स्ट्तर पर मैप दकया िाएगा, परन्तु उनके पास उनके सेिाकाल में कम से कम 10 क्रेजडट पॉइंट हों। (ii) 7िें केन्रीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर-12 में सहायक प्रोफेसर ग्रेड-I को सातिें केन्रीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर-13क2 में एसोजसएट प्रोफेसर के स्ट्तर पर मैप दकया िाएगा, बिते दक उनके पास उनके
title: Annexure-II b Gazette Notification 2023

Annexure-II b Gazette Notification 2023
आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर-13क2 में एसोजसएट प्रोफेसर के स्ट्तर पर मैप दकया िाएगा, बिते दक उनके पास उनके सेिाकाल में कम से कम 25 क्रेजडट पॉइंट हों। (iii) 7िें केन्रीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर-13क1 में एसोजसएट प्रोफेसर को 7िें केन्रीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के स्ट्तर-13क2 में एसोजसएट-प्रोफेसर के स्ट्तर पर मैप दकया िाएगा, बिते दक उनके पास उनके सेिाकाल में कम से कम 25 क्रेजडट पॉइंट हों: परन्तु उन्हें पररजनयमों के अधीन जिजधित गरठत एक चयन सजमजत के माध्यम से उपयुि पाया गया हो।"; (III) पैरा (7) के स्ट्थान पर, जनम्नजलजखत पैरा को रखा िाएगा, अथाडत्: - "(7) िास्ट्तुकला जिभाग में संकाय के स्ट्थान पर सहायक प्रोफेसर स्ट्तर पर क्रेजडट प्िाइंट की अपेक्षाओं पर बल दिए जबना जनम्नजलजखत अजनिायड अहडताएँ होंगी: 4 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART III—SEC.4] (i) एक िषड के व्यािसाजयक अनुभि के साथ एम.आकड अथिा एम.प्लान: 7िें केन्रीय िेतन आयोग के िेतन मैररक्स के

Guidelines and SoP for Student Exchange Programme (SEP) for UG and PG students of NITJ
Guidelines and SoP for Student Exchange Program (SEP) for UG and PG students of NIT Jalandhar under MoU with foreign institutions (Approved by BoG in its 61st Meeting) Application Process: Eligibility: 1. The students of NIT Jalandhar can apply for SEP at a foreign Institution with whom NIT Jalandhar has an MoU 2. Before proceeding on SEP Student must have completed 4 Semesters (UG), 2 Semesters (PG) stay at NIT Jalandhar 3. A minimum CGPA of 7.0 without any backlog at the time of application is required. 4. No disciplinary action should be pending, and the student should not be under any disciplinary penalty period. Host Institute Selection Criterion: To be followed as per the MoU with the concerned foreign Institution. Course Selection during Student exchange duration*: 1. The student must choose courses at the host institution such that the minimum equivalent credit requirement of the corresponding semester in his program of study at NIT Jalandhar is satisfied. 2. All proposed host-institution courses and their corresponding NITJ courses must be
title: Guidelines and SoP for Student Exchange Programme (SEP) for UG and PG students of NITJ

equivalent credit requirement of the corresponding semester in his program of study at NIT Jalandhar is satisfied. 2. All proposed host-institution courses and their corresponding NITJ courses must be entered in the SEP Application Form (Annexure–1). 3. Students may opt for courses offered in any semester/program at the host university, provided: a. The courses are academically relevant and contribute to the student’s academic or professional growth, b. They are permitted by the host university, and c. They are not repeated at NITJ 4. If a student misses any course at NIT Jalandhar due to participation in the exchange semester, and that course is needed for understanding future coursework, the student will be responsible for independently covering the required concepts through self-study or additional learning as advised by the department. * In special circumstances/exigencies, the guidelines for Eligibility, and Course Selection during Student exchange duration, may be relaxed with approval of competent authority. Financial: NIT Jalandhar does not provide financial support for participation in SEP.

OBJECTIVES OF THE COURSE The objective of this one-week Short-Term Course is to provide participants with a comprehensive understanding of research methodology and to develop essential research skills. Specifically, the course seeks to:  Introduce participants to the fundamental principles, types, and significance of research in academic and professional contexts.  Enable participants to identify and formulate research problems, objectives, and hypotheses systematically.  Familiarize them with appropriate research designs, sampling methods, and tools for data collection.  Develop competence in data analysis and interpretation using basic statistical techniques.  Promote awareness of research ethics, plagiarism prevention, and proper referencing styles.  Equip participants with the ability to prepare well-structured research proposals, reports, and papers. This program is designed to build a strong foundation in research methodology and inspire participants to undertake high-quality, impactful research in their respective fields. COURSE CONTENTS The important contents of the short term course are as follows:  Introduction to Research, Research Design, Data collection, Sample design, Sampling Techniques.

Train- ees analyze the chemistry and thermal characteristics of various cells, including cylindri- cal and prismatic types, before moving to the structural assembly of a high-performance battery pack. R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar, conducted a two-day National Workshop on “Mobile Security Threats and Forensics” from February 1 to February 2, 2026. The event was a joint initiative of NIT Jalandhar and IIT Jammu, aligned with the objectives of the Information Security Education and Awareness (ISEA) project of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). AMBEDKAR NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY JALANDHAR DEPARTMENT OF ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING 8 - 9 May, 2026 The global push toward decarbonization has accelerated the transition from conventional fossil-fuel-based energy systems to sustainable, low-carbon, and ultimately net-zero energy solutions. India’s commitments under the Paris Agreement and the target of achieving net-zero emissions by 2070 call for trans- formative innovation, policy reforms, and strategic collaborations. In this context, the Department of Electrical Engineering proposes to organize a National Con- ference on “Net-Zero Energy Systems, 2026”, bringing together academia, industry, policymakers, and research organizations to discuss the latest ad- vancements and emerging pathways in clean energy technologies. Dr. B. R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology Jalandhar is among the 31 NITs established by Ministry of Education (earlier MHRD), Govt. of India. The nstitute came into existence in the year 1987 (earlier Regional Engineering Col- lege, Jalandhar) and obtained the status “Institute of National Importance” by Act of Parliament 2007. The institute is offering B.Tech., M.Sc., M.Tech., and Ph.D.

Call for Papers About the Conference IC3AI-2026 is the 1st International Conference on Computing, Communication, and Artificial Intelligence, organized by the Department of Information Technology, Dr. B. R. Ambedkar NIT Jalandhar, scheduled during December 18–19, 2026. The conference aims to create a premier forum for researchers, academicians, and industry leaders to present cutting-edge research, exchange ideas, and explore collaborations across AI, computing, communication, cybersecurity, and emerging digital technologies. Accepted and presented papers will be submitted to IEEE Xplore subject to quality and review. Technical Tracks Track 1 - Computing, Communication and Artificial Intelligence Track 2 - Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics Track 3 - Advanced Computing and Application Track 4 - Security and Privacy with IoT Track 5 - 6G Communication and Beyond Track 6 - Physiology and Artificial intelligence Track 7 - AI/ML in Computational Biology Track 8 - AI/ML in Affective Computing Track 9 - AI/ML Applications in Core Engineering Track 10 - Blockchain and NLP for Real time Application Submission Deadlines

The speakers for this event were Prof. Neelima Satyam, Prof. V A Sawant, Prof. G R Dodagoudar and Dr. Meghana Sharma organised by Department of Civil Engineering, Dr B R Ambedkar NIT Jalandhar in association with IGS Jalandhar Chapter. The inaugural was graced by Dr. A P Singh (Honorary Secretary of IGS), Prof. B K Kanaujia, Director, NIT Jalandhar, Prof. A K Agnihotri (Head, Civil Engineering and Chairman IGS Jalandhar Chapter), Dr. H S Chore (Convenor), Dr. S. Rupali and Dr. K. Senthil (organising secretary), other faculty members and participants. The program focused on enhancing knowledge and understanding of geotechnical earthquake engineering. The program aimed to equip participants with valuable insights and practical knowledge to address the challenges associated with earthquakes and ensure the safety and resilience of the built environment. The program commenced with an introduction to earthquakes, covering the fundamental

The program commenced with an introduction to earthquakes, covering the fundamental principles of seismic activity and its implications for structures. Participants gained a comprehensive understanding of seismic hazard analysis, enabling them to assess and quantify the potential risks associated with earthquakes in specific regions. Ground response analysis, a crucial aspect of geotechnical earthquake engineering, formed a significant part of the program. Participants learned how to predict ground motions accurately and evaluate their impact on structures. This knowledge laid the foundation for designing robust foundations and optimizing structural performance to enhance overall safety. The program also focused on the seismic analysis of tunnels, highlighting the unique challenges posed by earthquakes on underground structures. Participants gained insights into effective mitigation measures to ensure the integrity of transportation and utility systems. India’s commitments under the Paris Agreement and the target of achieving net-zero emissions by 2070 call for trans- formative innovation, policy reforms, and strategic collaborations. Dr. B. R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology Jalandhar is among the 31 NITs established by Ministry of Education (earlier MHRD), Govt. of India. The nstitute came into existence in the year 1987 (earlier Regional Engineering Col- lege, Jalandhar) and obtained the status “Institute of National Importance” by Act of Parliament 2007. The institute is offering B.Tech., M.Sc., M.Tech., and Ph.D.

transformed modern healthcare infrastructure. However, these developments have also led to increased resource consumption, environmental impact, and financial burden. Sustainable growth in healthcare infrastructure is essential to ensure long-term efficiency, accessibility, resilience, and environmental responsibility. This Faculty Development Programme (FDP) aims to equip faculty members, researchers, and healthcare professionals with knowledge and skills to design, manage, and promote sustainable healthcare systems by integrating technological, economic, environmental, and social perspectives. Topic To be covered • Introduction to Sustainable Healthcare • Sustainable AI and its applications in healthcare • Sustainable AI based Internet of Medical Things • Resource optimization in Healthcare • Optimization techniques towards sustainable data processing in Healthcare • Research Methodology in Healthcare Sustainability • Advancing Healthcare through Indigenous Innovation in Diagnostic Technologies • IoT for Patient Monitoring • Case studies from hospitals Registration Link: https://www.nitj.ac.in/events_registration/fdp_sgmhi_2026/login Registration Fee Faculty, Research Scholar and Industry Participants Rs. 500/- +18%GST NITJ Faculty, Research Scholars, PG students Rs 300/- +18%GST Certificate of participation will be provided online. Farewell Ceremony-2026 The farewell ceremony held for our seniors was a memorable and emotional event, marking the end of an important chapter in their lives. The program was organized with great enthusiasm and began with a warm welcome to the faculty members and students. The venue was beautifully decorated, creating a vibrant and celebratory atmosphere. The event started with the traditional lamp lighting ceremony, symbolizing knowledge and positivity. This was followed by a series of cultural performances, including dance, music, and poetry, which added energy and excitement to the occasion. Students showcased their talents and dedicated their performances to the seniors as a token of love and respect. One of the highlights of the event was the title distribution, where fun and unique titles were awarded to the seniors, bringing smiles and laughter to everyone present. The announcement of “Mr. and Miss Farewell” created a sense of anticipation and joy. Shruti Seta was honored with
title: Farewell-1

awarded to the seniors, bringing smiles and laughter to everyone present. The announcement of “Mr. and Miss Farewell” created a sense of anticipation and joy. Shruti Seta was honored with the title of Miss Farewell, while Hitendra Singh Bhati was awarded the title of Mr. Farewell, receiving loud applause and appreciation from the audience. Several students and teachers shared their heartfelt speeches, expressing gratitude, memories, and best wishes for the seniors’ future. The seniors also shared their experiences, reflecting on their journey and the bond they had formed over the years. The event concluded with a vote of thanks, followed by dinner and a DJ session, where everyone celebrated together one last time. The farewell was not just a goodbye but a beautiful celebration of memories, friendships, and new beginnings, leaving everyone with emotions they will cherish forever.

What is Information? Information is any material in any form. It includes records, documents, memos, e-mails, opinions, advices, press releases, circulars, orders, logbooks, contracts, reports, papers, samples, models, data material held in any electronic form. It also includes information relating to any private body which can be accessed by the public authority under any law for the time being in force. Q.2. What is a Public Authority? A "public authority" is any authority or body or institution of self government established or constituted by or under the Constitution; or by any other law made by the Parliament or a State Legislature; or by notification issued or

established or constituted by or under the Constitution; or by any other law made by the Parliament or a State Legislature; or by notification issued or order made by the Central Government or a State Government. The bodies owned, controlled or substantially financed by the Central Government or a State Government and non-Government organisations substantially financed by the Central Government or a State Government also fall within the definition of public authority. The financing of the body or the NGO by the Government may be direct or indirect. Q.3 What is a Public Information Officer? Public authorities have designated some of its officers as Public Information Officer. They are responsible to give information to a person who seeks information under the RTI Act. Q.4. What is the Fee for Seeking Information from Central Government Public Authorities? A person who desires to seek some information from a Central Government Public Authority is required to send, along with the application, a demand

A person who desires to seek some information from a Central Government Public Authority is required to send, along with the application, a demand draft or a banker’s cheque or an Indian Postal Order of Rs.10/- (Rupees ten), payable to the Accounts Officer of the public authority as fee prescribed for seeking information. The payment of fee can also be made by way of cash to the Accounts Officer of the public authority or to the Assistant Public Information Officer against proper receipt. However, the RTI Fee and the mode of payment may vary as under Section 27 and Section 28, of the RTI Act, 2005 the appropriate Government and the competent authority, respectively, by notification in the Official Gazette, make rules to carry out the provisions of this Act. There is no prescribed format of application for seeking information. The application can be made on plain paper. The application should, however, have the name and complete postal address of the applicant. Q.7. Is it required to give any reason for seeking information? The information seeker is not required to give reasons for seeking information. Q.8. Is there any provision for exemption from Disclosure of Information?

The information seeker is not required to give reasons for seeking information. Q.8. Is there any provision for exemption from Disclosure of Information? Sub-section (1) of section 8 and section 9 of the Act enumerate the types of information which is exempt from disclosure. Sub-section (2) of section 8, however, provides that information exempted under sub-section 3 (1) or exempted under the Official Secrets Act, 1923 can be disclosed if public interest in disclosure overweighs the harm to the protected interest. Q.9. Is there any assistance available to the Applicant for filing RTI application? If a person is unable to make a request in writing, he may seek the help of the Public Information Officer to write his application and the Public Information Officer should render him reasonable assistance. Where a decision is taken to give access to a sensorily disabled person to any document, the Public Information Officer, shall provide such assistance to the person as may be appropriate for inspection.

It is to apprise that currently; the institute operates two Sewage Treatment Plants (STPs) whose details are as follow: (i) 1 MLD (Million Liters per Day) plant which was constructed in 2019, is functioning at approximately 80% of its designed capacity. “a Qe! 19 (ii) | 0.5 MLD plant. The 1 MLD plant which was built in 2011, is currently non-functional and requires significant repairs. Several of its essential components need to be repaired/replaced to restore its operation. Moreover, the sewage load at the institute has significantly increased due to the construction of new buildings and the growing number of users, including students, staff, and faculty members. At present, the sewage load ranges from 1.2 MLD to 1.5 MLD. With

Initiatives like GIAN (Global Initiative of Academic Networks) and SPARC (Scheme for Promotion of Academic and Research Collaboration) encourage faculty and student exchange with top global universities, fostering internationalization. text:
Supplementary Examination Notice 2026
1. A student obtaining 'U' grade in a theory course may register for a supplementary exam in that course. However, the supplementary exam will not be available for Laboratory Courses. 2. The maximum number of times a supplementary examination can be taken for each course is 02. If the student fails to clear the course in 02 supplementary chances, he/she will have to repeat the course as an additional course with U grade. 3. The candidates during supplementary exam shall be awarded one grade less than the actual grade obtained and maximum Grade awarded shall be ‘D’. However, an ‘E’ grade shall remain as ‘E’. 4. In case of any technical difficulty, please contact to webmaster@nitj.ac.in 5. All students are required to fill the online registration form carefully. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology Jalandhar, Punjab, India Theme: Sustainable Innovation through Flexible Strategies in the Era of Industry 4.0 and Industry 5.0 Hosted by: Department of Industrial and Production Engineering, Dr. B. R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology (NIT) Jalandhar Co-organizer: Graphic-Era University (Deemed to be the University) Dehradun ANNOUNCEMENT ‘GLOGIFT 26’, an International Conference with the theme “Sustainable Innovation through Flexible Strategies in the Era of Industry 4.0 and Industry 5.0” in an effort to provide a global forum for practitioners, policy makers, teachers, researchers, and students to share their practical experiences, knowledge and insight in the evolution, formulation and implementation of strategies and models for flexible enterprises to meet the changing requirements of global business. The objective of the conference is to provide a knowledge sharing platform for dissemination of research and experiential findings through empirical study, qualitative modeling, case studies, new concepts and state-of-the- art studies.

The appointment shall be purely on a contractual basis initially for a period of one year, extendable annually based on performance and requirements of the Incubator. Job Duties and Responsibilities The CEO will be responsible, primarily for achieving the objectives and goals of the NITJ Technology Business Incubator in a sustainable and growth-oriented manner. he/she will be the prime interface for entrepreneurs and responsible for managing the operations, planning, marketing and development of NITJ TBI. This position requires a team player with proven leadership qualities, excellent marketing & organization skills with a professional attitude. The CEO shall be responsible for the overall leadership, growth, and management of NITJ TBI, including but not limited to: • Developing and implementing strategic plans for incubation and entrepreneurship development. • Create Incubation plans and implement them, assist in writing business plans, keep track of the Incubation process, help the incubatees prepare proposals for getting funding etc. • Marketing the Incubator and actively promote it through various channels •

According to the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA), Renewable Energy Sources (RES) could supply half of global electricity demand by 2050, while EVs could account for 30%. Therefore, there is an urgent need to build the capacity of skilled workers to support the electric mobility sector of the country. In this con- text, a proposed workshop focuses on the technological, environmental, and eco- nomic aspects of EVs to promote sustainable mobility. Annexure I
Step-by-Step guide to Online Room Booking at NIT Jalandhar Important Note: Students (Boys) from Jalandhar and nearby areas should not participate in the online room booking process. If anyone is found participating in the online hostel room booking process during document verification, their room booking will be forfeited, and appropriate action may be taken against them. Step 1: Visit the following link Navigate to the NIT Jalandhar room booking portal (https://ha.nitj.ac.in/) and click on login. Step 2: Choose your year for login Step 3: Login to your account Use your Application ID, which is the same as your JEE Main/DASA/other exam Application ID, and your Password, which is the last four digits/characters of your application ID, followed by the @ symbol and DDMM from your date of birth. For example, if your application id is CS2365F4789 and your DOB is 01-01-2000, your password will be 4789@0101. Step 4: Fill the Registration form

This course is offered to first-year B Tech students from the Departments of Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, and Electronics & Communication Engineering. The course has been developed under the CBDE Programme, Government of India, with the objective of promoting creativity, design thinking, innovation, and experiential learning among students. Currently, around 480 students per semester are actively engaged in this lab. Students work in interdisciplinary teams consisting of Mechanical, CSE, and ECE students under the guidance of faculty mentors. The main objective of this lab is to encourage students to bring their own ideas and convert them into practical engineering solutions. The process begins with idea generation, followed by problem identification, solution development, and hands-on implementation through working prototypes and models. Department of Humanities and Management NIT Jalandhar to Organise Financial Literacy and Securities Market Awareness Programmes Dr B. R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology Jalandhar is organising a series of sponsored programmes on retirement planning, financial literacy and securities market awareness on 7–8 September 2026. The programmes, are sponsored by the National Institute of Securities Markets (NISM) and Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL). These programmes are designed for different sections of the NIT Jalandhar community, including faculty members, administrative officers, staff members, undergraduate students and MBA students. Through focused sessions, the participants will gain practical knowledge of retirement planning, financial decision-making and the functioning of securities markets. Programme Schedule Retirement Planning Programme: The NISM-sponsored “Retirement Planning” Programme is intended for faculty members and administrative officers of NIT Jalandhar. This comprehensive 5-day STC gives participants a strong conceptual and practical foundation in acquiring, conditioning, and analysing these vital bio-signals through lectures, demonstrations, and hands-on laboratory sessions. COURSE MODULES & HANDS-ON CURRICULUM ➤ Fundamentals of Physiological Signals: Origin of bioelectric potentials, electrode-tissue interface, ECG/EEG/EMG characteristics, and biomedical instrumentation standards and safety. ➤ ECG Acquisition & Analysis: Electrode placement, lead

About the Department About the Workshop The Research Methodology Course on “Data-Driven Research Methods in Social Sciences and Academic Research Integrity” is designed primarily for doctoral students actively engaged in research within the fields of Social Sciences, Commerce, and Management. Research in the social sciences is undergoing a significant transformation. Today, researchers across various disciplines are expected to work with diverse forms of evidence such as survey data, administrative datasets, qualitative interviews, experimental designs, and even digital footprints generated by technology-based platforms. This shift has created new opportunities for rigorous inquiry, but it has also introduced challenges for scholars who lack formal training in modern research methods, analytical tools, and publication standards. At the same time, increased emphasis on research ethics, data transparency, and integrity requires scholars to adopt responsible research practices and avoid common academic pitfalls.

In this context, the RMC on “Data-Driven Research Methods in Social Sciences and Academic Research Integrity” is proposed as a structured and highly practical learning programme. The workshop offers a complete research skill-building journey, beginning from research foundations and moving towards advanced quantitative, qualitative, and experimental techniques. It also incorporates hands-on exposure to widely used research tools such as STATA, Smart PLS, NVivo/ATLAS.ti, and reference management software, enabling participants to translate conceptual knowledge into real academic outputs.
